<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode layer on MI355X (gfx950): a decoder layer of a decode step as two persistent FlyDSL launches at TP8, opt-in with `--monokernel`. It is a standalone package, `vllm/models/deepseek_v4/amd/mono/`, docked by `deepseek_v4/amd/mono_decode.py`, in the layout and style of the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash mono layer. No shared abstraction and no DeepSeek-V4.1 file is touched.

Related: RFC #60904; #61311 proposes the runtime layer for specialized decode kernels, which this PR does not touch.

**Attribution:** This work builds on [ROCm/ATOM's DeepSeek-V4.1 mono decode implementation](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/tree/97359d6df46c59736468168b7be8bc50b482a1a9/atom/models/deepseek_v41/mono), via vLLM's V4.1-Flash mono layer. ATOM contributed the reference persistent execution framework, synchronization, peer memory, mHC seam and MoE stages adapted here for Pro. The source files retain their ATOM origins, AMD copyright and MIT attribution; the package README now links the original implementation explicitly.

## Claims

- Verified on 8× MI355X, TP8, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, DSpark K6, with the baseline's pinned AgentX client, synthetic acceptance 3.77, and one 3600-second run per point. Reused InferenceX run 35968440959 attempt 1; no performance baseline rerun. The table compares that historical baseline with current checkout `df6603f05833` plus this PR's patch (`506973f0d701`).

| Concurrency | P50 tok/s/user, baseline → candidate | Change | P90 slow-tail tok/s/user, baseline → candidate | Output tok/s, baseline → candidate | Errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| c1 | 221.45 → 285.03 | +28.7% | 205.43 → 250.06 | 119.53 → 134.10 | 0 |
| c4 | 205.30 → 259.79 | +26.5% | 167.96 → 195.33 | 198.41 → 208.53 | 0 |
| c8 | 181.00 → 202.48 | +11.9% | 126.60 → 132.29 | 356.40 → 367.61 | 0 |

  The candidate uses a newer vLLM/Torch/ROCm stack; these deltas do not isolate the PR. Duration-based replay also completes different request mixes. Full configuration, quality results and limitations: [verification report](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61482#issuecomment-6359694623).

- The package is Pro's own copy, specialized to its widths and numerics: no `MonoSpec`, no FFN-only launch, no V4.1 delayed seam. It compiles to the same ISA as the previous revision of this PR (45 K1 / K2 variants, identical modulo immediates and register counts).

Validation completed on a second 8× MI355X machine. The accuracy investigation and remaining review follow-ups are summarized below.

## Validation

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py` (TP8, MI355X) | 1 passed. Whole layer (K1 + K2) against vLLM's own ops and an exact fp32 reference: CSA and HCA layers (key tables 512 / 2048 wide), bias and hash routing, 7-56 rows, one- and two-hop all-reduce, 200 graph replays. |
| `pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_layers.py` (TP8, MI355X) | 1 passed in this verification (264.12 s). A five-layer Pro on random weights, mono on vs off, every layer's outputs at every decode step. |
| `pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_decode.py` (CPU) | 25 passed: the docking's path choice and the startup refusals. |
| `pre-commit` | Author-reported earlier check passes, including mypy and CI wiring; not rerun as part of this verification. |
| ISA, 45 Pro K1 / K2 variants, `FLYDSL_DUMP_IR` + `COMPILE_ONLY`, vs the previous revision | Author-reported earlier check: identical modulo immediates; same register and spill counts. |
| GPQA-Diamond / AIME25 / NIAH, real DSpark K6 | Mono off → on: GPQA 155/198 → 158/198; AIME 26/30 → 24/30 at 32K output budget; NIAH 100% → 100% across 640 prompts per mode through 512K. See investigation below before interpreting the AIME delta. |
| AgentX c1 / c4 / c8, historical baseline → current mono | Completed, 3600 s per concurrency, 2,022 measured requests, zero request errors; P50 tok/s/user +28.7% / +26.5% / +11.9%. This historical comparison includes software-stack differences. |

CI: the MI355 Basic Models step runs the docking test, and a new `mi355_8` job runs the numerics and layer tests. Neither runs in upstream CI without MI355 runners.

## Accuracy investigation and review follow-ups

The 32K evaluation had 31 empty final GPQA answers per mode and 5 AIME empties with mono on versus 4 off; these were counted incorrect. A selected 65,536-token diagnostic reran the 23 GPQA disagreements and all 7 AIME questions missed by either mode. GPQA scored 17/23 in both modes; AIME scored 7/7 on and 6/7 off. These selected scores do not replace full-suite scores. Four recovered mono-on AIME answers needed more than 32K output tokens, and the prior nonempty arithmetic error did not repeat. One mono-off GPQA response still hit the 65,536-token limit. The remaining mono-off AIME miss stopped on the task's literal `Question:` string inside reasoning. A separate probe with that string removed returned correct=1, empty=False, finish_reason=stop. Some recovered answers also finished below 32K, so run/batch variation matters; these single runs do not establish accuracy equivalence or a kernel precision regression. [Full results, raw-response findings and reproduction details](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61482#issuecomment-6359694623).

The benchmark run excluded the then-conflicting Buildkite YAML hunk. Latest merge commit `4b8630240e` merged upstream main and resolved the renewed CI conflict. The upstream MuseSpark logits/shared-RoPE test command is preserved verbatim, and the Pro mono docking test now runs in its own command to avoid editing the shared test list. Its docking suite passes all 25 tests. YAML parsing, Buildkite step-key checks, test tethering, and pre-commit pass. The production runtime files remain byte-for-byte identical to the benchmarked checkout; the subsequent FFN test-reference correction is described below. Performance and accuracy measurements were not rerun after merging the newer main. The package README documents usage; rendered documentation for the new supported model/backend remains a contribution-checklist follow-up. These measurements support human review and are not a merge approval. Verification and report preparation used Codex.

### CI numerics follow-up

[Buildkite 96962](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96962#01a16aa5-005d-47bd-b710-1ce557f86492) failed the FFN normalized-input comparison. The test checked the kernel's input against a fused-seam result derived from a separately rounded residual, although its contract is to compare each stage on its own input. The FFN normalization reference now uses `MHCPreOp` on the kernel's actual residual. The residual and fp32 post/comb checks remain, all tolerances are unchanged, and assertion failures include the rank, cosine similarity and relative L2 error. No runtime kernels changed.

The exact CI failure was **not reproduced locally**: the unchanged test passed with the normal cache, a fresh FlyDSL cache, ten diagnostic seeds, and the exact precompiled AITER package extracted from CI's base image. Across 320 diagnostic observations, maximum relative L2 error was 0.0027080 for the previous reference and 0.00014153 for the reference on the actual residual. These observations support the input-isolation correction; they do not establish the full cause of the original CI failure. No fail-before/pass-after claim is made.

Commit `ea98f386f6`: on 8× MI355X, with CI's extracted AITER Python package and precompiled binaries (local `aiter_meta` assets), the combined command below passed **27 tests in 159.58 s**. Targeted pre-commit passed, including mypy and Buildkite test tethering. Logs, extracted package and diagnostics are retained under `dsv4_rocm_bench/ci-96962/`. The `/ci run` command automatically merged newer upstream main as `f6445bf2487c`. The same three suites then passed again on that exact merged head: **27 passed in 173.38 s**. The merge leaves Pro runtime and test files unchanged. Fresh [upstream CI #97001](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/97001) and [AMD CI #15314](https://buildkite.com/vllm/amd-ci/builds/15314) have started; their final results are pending.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_layers.py tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_decode.py -v -s
pre-commit run --files tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py vllm/models/deepseek_v4/amd/mono/README.md
```

## Details

- **Layout.** Same as V4.1's: `common/` (execution model, mailbox, peer memory, MX arithmetic), `stages/` (mHC seam, MoE, router, all-reduce), `attention/` (sparse-MLA front and back), `layer.py`, `runner.py`, `dims.py` (Pro's widths and a TP rank's share). See `README.md` in the package.
- **What Pro needs beyond V4.1:** the non-delayed mHC seam (aiter's `mhc_pre` collapse), a weightless per-head q RMSNorm, aiter's (16, 16)-preshuffled FP8 weights with `VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING` row strides, hash routing for layers 0-2, HCA layers reading every compressed row from vLLM's c128a table, and 128 x 128 block scales expanded exactly to the kernels' 32 x 32 E8M0 scales.
- **HCA key table.** At a 1M context the table is 8192 rows wide; the key table, split units and combine cover each token's own keys only (`bounded`).
- **Two-hop all-reduce** from 42 rows: 2/tp of the bytes of one hop, bit-identical.
- **Limits:** TP8 only; the compressor and indexer run as vLLM ops between K1 and K2, serially; the draft layers keep vLLM's path.
- **Duplication.** The package copies V4.1's `common/` and the generic stages rather than sharing them, as asked, so each model's kernels evolve independently. The previous revision of this PR shared them in `vllm/models/common/amd/mono/`.
- AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for the implementation, the tests and this description. The human submitter remains responsible for reviewing every changed line and validating the change before merge.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. Rendered documentation follow-up remains.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

### AgentX performance

Reused [InferenceX run 35968440959, attempt 1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/35968440959/attempts/1); **the performance baseline was not rerun**. c2 was skipped as requested. One 3600-second measurement per concurrency with the baseline’s exact AgentX client commit `754356e9a39acc6cc6afb242d123bb57c3fb6f75`, 393 trace entries, seed 42, DSpark K6, synthetic acceptance length 3.77, FP8 KV, AITER, shared-expert fusion disabled.

| Concurrency | P50 tok/s/user, baseline → candidate | Change | P90 slow-tail tok/s/user, baseline → candidate | Output tok/s, baseline → candidate | Errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| c1 | 221.45 → 285.03 | +28.7% | 205.43 → 250.06 | 119.53 → 134.10 | 0 |
| c4 | 205.30 → 259.79 | +26.5% | 167.96 → 195.33 | 198.41 → 208.53 | 0 |
| c8 | 181.00 → 202.48 | +11.9% | 126.60 → 132.29 | 356.40 → 367.61 | 0 |

**Comparison limits:** the historical baseline uses vLLM `e9757321527c`, while this candidate uses the newer local vLLM/Torch/ROCm stack. These deltas do not isolate the PR’s effect. Duration-based replay completes a different request mix as speed changes; prompt/output lengths and cache-hit rates are recorded in the artifacts. One run per point does not measure run-to-run variance. All 2,022 measured candidate requests succeeded.

### Accuracy with real rejection sampling

Same local software/checkpoint for mono on/off: `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813`, revision `72e1d3230f6c080a530b0a1d46f8eb4602340597`, DSpark K6 with probabilistic drafts and real rejection sampling. GPQA/AIME: zero-shot, temperature 0, evaluation seed 42, HTTP request seed 1234 (lm_eval default), 32,768 output-token budget; default high reasoning. Matched GPQA/AIME prompt hashes were identical across modes.

| Full suite | Mono off | Mono on |
|---|---:|---:|
| GPQA-Diamond, flexible answer extraction | 155/198 (78.28%) | 158/198 (79.80%) |
| AIME25, exact match | 26/30 (86.67%) | 24/30 (80.00%) |
| RULER NIAH reference recall | 100% (640 prompts) | 100% (640 prompts) |

NIAH covers all eight variants × 4K/32K/128K/512K × 20 prompts, with identical saved prompts, thinking disabled, temperature 0, seed 42, and max output 256. Every one of the 32 variant/length cases scored 1.0 in each mode. This is sampled NIAH coverage, not the full RULER suite.

### Accuracy investigation

The 32K run had 31 empty final GPQA answers in **each** mode, and 5 AIME empties with mono on versus 4 off; all count as incorrect. There were 23 paired GPQA disagreements (13 on-only correct, 10 off-only correct), 13 involving an empty answer. Of four AIME disagreements, three involved an empty answer; the other was an actual divisor-counting error in the mono-on answer.

Reran the identical prompts for all 23 GPQA disagreements and all 7 AIME questions missed by either mode, using a 65,536-token budget and saving raw responses, finish reasons, usage, and reasoning. **This selected diagnostic subset does not replace the full-suite scores above.**

| Selected diagnostic subset | Mono off correct | Mono on correct | Empty finals off / on |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GPQA disagreements | 17/23 | 17/23 | 1 / 0 |
| AIME previously missed | 6/7 | 7/7 | 1 / 0 |

The remaining mono-off AIME diagnostic miss was **not a length stop**: its raw response reports `stop_reason=Question:` after 27,495 reasoning tokens and no final content. The inherited AIME task includes this literal stop string, so quoting `Question:` during reasoning terminates the request. A separate mono-off probe removed only that string, retained the 65,536-token budget, and returned `finish_reason=stop`, 35,136 output tokens, empty=False, correct=1. This one-question probe is reported separately; it also changes batch composition. The original lm_eval run did not retain raw finish reasons, so not every original empty response can be individually classified.

One mono-off GPQA diagnostic remained empty with `finish_reason=length` at 65,536 tokens. Budget limits therefore remain relevant even in the larger-budget diagnostic.

Mono-on recovered all seven selected AIME cases, including correct responses requiring 33,278, 48,205, 62,876 and 44,826 output tokens. These responses would exceed the original 32K budget. The original nonempty arithmetic error also did not repeat. Some recovered answers finished below 32K, so run/batch variation contributes as well; the larger-budget rerun changes batch composition and does not isolate budget effects. The full-suite difference cannot be treated as a proven kernel precision regression, and these single runs do not establish accuracy equivalence.

### Numerical checks and reproduction

- Docking/path-selection checks: **25 passed**.
- TP8 whole-layer numerical/reference test, including 200 graph replays: **1 passed**.
- Five-layer mono on/off comparison: **1 passed**. These checks validate tolerances, not bitwise equality between implementations.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_decode.py -q
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py -v -s
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_layers.py -v -s
.venv/bin/python dsv4_rocm_bench/run_verification.py
.venv/bin/python dsv4_rocm_bench/run_accuracy_diagnostics.py
.venv/bin/python dsv4_rocm_bench/run_stop_probe.py
```

Local artifacts: `/home/fai/vllm/dsv4_rocm_bench` — frozen PR patch/SHA, hardware/package manifest, baseline downloads, exact server/client command JSON and environment, preflight commands/logs, AgentX exports/aggregates, per-question eval outputs, saved NIAH prompts/results, raw diagnostic responses, and comparison tables. Writable FlyDSL/AITER cache configuration and environment fixes are recorded in the runner and verification notes. Candidate package versions: Torch 2.13.0+rocm10.0.0, vLLM 0.32.1rc1.dev276+gdf6603f05.empty, FlyDSL 0.4.0, lm_eval 0.4.13. Requested graph mode was automatically resolved by this model to FULL_DECODE_ONLY; logs preserve the effective configuration.

**Review follow-ups:** the Buildkite YAML hunk conflicts with the newer local base and was excluded from this local patch; runtime/test hunks were applied. CI wiring and upstream merge-conflict resolution are not covered by these measurements. The package README documents usage, while rendered documentation for the new model/backend remains a contribution-checklist follow-up. This report supports human review and is not a merge approval.

- **Layout.** Same as V4.1's: `common/` (execution model, mailbox, peer memory, MX arithmetic), `stages/` (mHC seam, MoE, router, all-reduce), `attention/` (sparse-MLA front and back), `layer.py`, `runner.py`, `dims.py` (Pro's widths and a TP rank's share). See `README.md` in the package.
- **What Pro needs beyond V4.1:** the non-delayed mHC seam (aiter's `mhc_pre` collapse), a weightless per-head q RMSNorm, aiter's (16, 16)-preshuffled FP8 weights with `VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING` row strides, hash routing for layers 0-2, HCA layers reading every compressed row from vLLM's c128a table, and 128 x 128 block scales expanded exactly to the kernels' 32 x 32 E8M0 scales.
- **HCA key table.** At a 1M context the table is 8192 rows wide; the key table, split units and combine cover each token's own keys only (`bounded`).
- **Two-hop all-reduce** from 42 rows: 2/tp of the bytes of one hop, bit-identical.
- **Limits:** TP8 only; the compressor and indexer run as vLLM ops between K1 and K2, serially; the draft layers keep vLLM's path.
- **Duplication.** The package copies V4.1's `common/` and the generic stages rather than sharing them, as asked, so each model's kernels evolve independently. The previous revision of this PR shared them in `vllm/models/common/amd/mono/`.
- AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for the implementation, the tests and this description. The human submitter remains responsible for reviewing every changed line and validating the change before merge.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode layer runs only where its kernels are exact:
+decode-only steps of at most 64 rows with causal SWA windows, eager or in a
+FULL graph. Every backbone layer takes the whole layer: a CSA layer through
+its top-k (its compressor and indexer run between the launches), an HCA layer
+through every compressed row (vLLM's c128a table), a hash-routed layer with
+its tokens' experts. Deployments the kernels cannot run are an error."""
+
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd import mono_decode as md
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd.mono.dims import HIDDEN, MAX_TOKENS, WINDOW
+
+M = 6
+HCA_WIDTH = 512
+DEFAULT = object()
+
+
+class _Runner:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        self.calls.append((args, kwargs))
+        return ("x", "residual", "post_mix", "res_mix", "extra")
+
+
+def _cache(block):
+    return torch.zeros(4, block * md.RECORD, dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _layer(ratio=md.CSA, tid2eid=None):
+    attn = SimpleNamespace(
+        prefix="comp",
+        swa_cache_layer=SimpleNamespace(prefix="swa", kv_cache=_cache(64)),
+        kv_cache=_cache(64),
+        compress_ratio=ratio,
+        topk_indices_buffer=torch.zeros(64, 1024, dtype=torch.int32),
+    )
+    ffn = SimpleNamespace(gate=SimpleNamespace(tid2eid=tid2eid))
+    return SimpleNamespace(attn=attn, ffn=ffn)
+
+
+def _swa(**overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        num_prefills=0,
+        num_decodes=1,
+        num_decode_tokens=M,
+        decode_swa_width=WINDOW,
+        decode_swa_indices=torch.zeros(64, 1, WINDOW, dtype=torch.int32),
+        decode_swa_lens=torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.int32),
+        token_to_req_indices=torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.int32),
+        slot_mapping=torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.int64),
+        block_size=64,
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**fields)
+
+
+def _c128a(rows=M, width=128):
+    """VLLM's c128a decode table: its step's rows of a 64-row buffer as wide as
+    the longest context, cut to the step's active width."""
+    buffer = torch.arange(64 * HCA_WIDTH, dtype=torch.int32).view(64, HCA_WIDTH)
+    return buffer[:rows, :width].view(rows, 1, -1)
+
+
+def _comp(rows=M, **overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        block_size=256,
+        block_table=torch.zeros(1, 4, dtype=torch.int32),
+        c128a_global_decode_topk_indices=_c128a(rows),
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**fields)
+
+
+def _inputs(rows=M):
+    return dict(
+        x=torch.zeros(rows, 4, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        positions=torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.int64),
+        input_ids=torch.arange(rows),
+        residual=torch.zeros(rows, 4, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        post_mix=torch.zeros(rows, 4, 1),
+        res_mix=torch.zeros(rows, 4, 4),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def run(monkeypatch):
+    """Call the mono path for one layer under a forward context built from
+    ``mode`` and ``metadata``; returns (result, runner calls). ``run.built``
+    records the runner's build arguments."""
+    built: list = []
+
+    def _run(mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL, metadata=DEFAULT, layer=None, **inputs):
+        if metadata is DEFAULT:
+            metadata = {"swa": _swa(), "comp": _comp()}
+        fc = SimpleNamespace(cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode, attn_metadata=metadata)
+        runner = _Runner()
+        monkeypatch.setattr(md, "is_forward_context_available", lambda: True)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(md, "get_forward_context", lambda: fc)
+
+        def build(*args):
+            built.append(args)
+            return runner
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(md, "_mono_runner", build)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(md.MonoDecodeLayer, "weights", lambda self, layer: None)
+        mono = md.MonoDecodeLayer(HCA_WIDTH)
+        return mono(layer or _layer(), **{**_inputs(), **inputs}), runner.calls
+
+    _run.built = built  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return _run
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", [CUDAGraphMode.NONE, CUDAGraphMode.FULL])
+def test_csa_step_runs_mono_with_its_topk(run, mode):
+    layer = _layer()
+    out, calls = run(mode, layer=layer)
+    assert out == ("x", "residual", "post_mix", "res_mix") and len(calls) == 1
+    kwargs = calls[0][1]
+    assert kwargs["topk_indices"] is layer.attn.topk_indices_buffer
+    # the CSA cache: a 256-token page holds 64 compressed records
+    assert kwargs["comp_cache"].shape == (4, 64, md.RECORD)
+    assert kwargs["fold"] and kwargs["route_ids"] is None
+    assert "global_keys" not in kwargs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ratio, indexed, expected",
+    [
+        (md.CSA, True, ["compressor", "indexer", "topk"]),
+        # a short context's top-k is every row, already filled
+        (md.CSA, False, ["compressor", "indexer"]),
+        (md.HCA, False, ["compressor"]),
+    ],
+    ids=["csa", "csa-short-context", "hca"],
+)
+def test_select_runs_the_compressor_then_the_indexer(run, ratio, indexed, expected):
+    """Between K1 and K2 the layer's compressor writes its row and a CSA
+    layer's indexer selects the top-k from K1's normed input and qr."""
+    log = []
+    normed = torch.empty(M, HIDDEN, device="meta")
+    qr = torch.empty(M, 1536, device="meta")
+    q = torch.empty(M, 4, device="meta") if indexed else None
+
+    class Compressor:
+        fused_wkv_wgate = SimpleNamespace(weight=torch.empty(8, HIDDEN, device="meta"))
+
+        def __call__(self, score, positions, rope):
+            log.append("compressor")
+
+    class Indexer:
+        compressor = Compressor()
+
+        def weights_proj(self, x):
+            return x[:, :4], None
+
+        def __call__(self, x, q_rank, score, weights, positions, rope):
+            assert x is normed and q_rank is qr
+            log.append("indexer")
+            return q, None, weights
+
+        def indexer_op(self, x, index_q, _, weights):
+            assert x is normed and index_q is q
+            log.append("topk")
+
+    layer = _layer(ratio)
+    layer.attn.compressor = Compressor()
+    layer.attn.indexer = Indexer() if ratio == md.CSA else None
+    layer.attn.rotary_emb = layer.attn.indexer_rotary_emb = None
+    _, calls = run(layer=layer)
+    calls[0][1]["select"](normed, qr)
+    assert log == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("decode_tokens", [M, M - 2], ids=["exact", "padded"])
+def test_hca_step_reads_every_compressed_row(run, decode_tokens):
+    """An HCA layer's keys are its c128a table's rows: the runner is built as
+    wide as vLLM's table, and the kernels read the table's buffer at its row
+    stride. A FULL graph padded past the step's decode tokens reads its pad
+    rows from the same buffer (their slots are -1)."""
+    comp = _comp(rows=decode_tokens)
+    metadata = {"swa": _swa(num_decode_tokens=decode_tokens), "comp": comp}
+    out, calls = run(metadata=metadata, layer=_layer(ratio=md.HCA))
+    assert out is not None and len(calls) == 1
+    assert [args[1] for args in run.built] == [HCA_WIDTH]
+    kwargs = calls[0][1]
+    assert kwargs["global_keys"] and kwargs["topk"] == HCA_WIDTH
+    keys = kwargs["topk_indices"]
+    table = comp.c128a_global_decode_topk_indices
+    assert keys.data_ptr() == table.data_ptr() and keys.stride(0) == HCA_WIDTH
+    assert keys.untyped_storage().nbytes() >= M * HCA_WIDTH * keys.element_size()
+    assert kwargs["comp_cache"].shape == (4, 2, md.RECORD)
+
+
+def test_hash_layer_routes_its_tokens(run):
+    tid2eid = torch.arange(100 * 6).view(100, 6)
+    ids = torch.tensor([3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9])
+    out, calls = run(layer=_layer(tid2eid=tid2eid), input_ids=ids)
+    assert out is not None
+    assert torch.equal(calls[0][1]["route_ids"], tid2eid[ids])
+
+
+def test_first_layer_runs_mono_from_the_embedding(run):
+    """The first layer's residual is the embedding broadcast to the four
+    streams, which K1 takes as it is (no owed post to fold)."""
+    out, calls = run(residual=None, post_mix=None, res_mix=None)
+    assert out is not None and len(calls) == 1
+    args, kwargs = calls[0]
+    assert args[2] is args[1] and not kwargs["fold"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case",
+    [
+        dict(mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE),
+        dict(metadata={"swa": _swa(num_prefills=1), "comp": _comp()}),
+        dict(metadata=None),  # a profile / dummy run
+        dict(metadata={"swa": _swa()}),
+        dict(
+            metadata={
+                "swa": _swa(),
+                "comp": _comp(c128a_global_decode_topk_indices=None),
+            },
+            layer=_layer(ratio=md.HCA),
+        ),
+        dict(**_inputs(MAX_TOKENS + 1)),
+        dict(residual=torch.zeros(M, HIDDEN, 4, dtype=torch.bfloat16).mT),
+        dict(layer=_layer(tid2eid=torch.zeros(100, 6)), input_ids=None),
+    ],
+    ids=[
+        "piecewise",
+        "prefill",
+        "no-metadata",
+        "no-comp-metadata",
+        "no-c128a-metadata",
+        "rows",
+        "non-contiguous",
+        "hash-without-ids",
+    ],
+)
+def test_other_steps_take_the_original_path(run, case):
+    out, calls = run(**case)
+    assert out is None and not calls
+
+
+def _decoder_layer(layer_id=5, **attn):
+    attn = (
+        dict(
+            prefix=f"model.layers.{layer_id}.attn",
+            compress_ratio=md.CSA,
+            indexer=object(),
+            kv_cache_dtype="fp8_ds_mla",
+        )
+        | attn
+    )
+    quant_method = SimpleNamespace(mxfp4_backend=Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16)
+    ffn = SimpleNamespace(
+        experts=SimpleNamespace(
+            routed_experts=SimpleNamespace(quant_method=quant_method)
+        ),
+        shared_experts=object(),
+        use_mega_moe=False,
+        fuse_heterogeneous_shared_expert=False,
+        is_fused_shared_expert_enabled=False,
+        gate=SimpleNamespace(tid2eid=None, bias_vl=None),
+        n_routed_experts=384,
+        n_activated_experts=6,
+        routed_scaling_factor=2.5,
+        swiglu_limit=10.0,
+        scoring_func="sqrtsoftplus",
+        renormalize=True,
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        attn=SimpleNamespace(**attn),
+        ffn=ffn,
+        use_fused_mhc=True,
+        fuse_mhc_rmsnorm=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _config(monokernel=True, max_model_len=8192):
+    parallel = dict(
+        enable_expert_parallel=False, enable_eplb=False, data_parallel_size=1
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(num_hidden_layers=61),
+            max_model_len=max_model_len,
+        ),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(**parallel),
+        kernel_config=SimpleNamespace(monokernel=monokernel),
+    )
+
+
+def _deployment(monkeypatch, tp=8, aiter_linear=True):
+    """A deployment the kernels take (the runner module stubbed: no FlyDSL)."""
+    import vllm.platforms.rocm as rocm
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm, "get_cdna_version", lambda: 4)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(md, "get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: tp)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(md, "_compute_units", lambda: 256)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rocm_aiter_ops, "is_linear_fp8_enabled", classmethod(lambda cls: aiter_linear)
+    )
+    name = "vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd.mono.runner"
+    runner = ModuleType(name)
+    runner.BLOCKS = 256  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, name, runner)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "layer, eligible",
+    [
+        (_decoder_layer(), True),
+        (_decoder_layer(compress_ratio=md.HCA, indexer=None), True),
+        (_decoder_layer(layer_id=61), False),
+    ],
+    ids=["csa", "hca", "draft"],
+)
+def test_backbone_layers_take_the_whole_layer(monkeypatch, layer, eligible):
+    _deployment(monkeypatch)
+    mono = md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(layer, _config())
+    assert (mono is not None) == eligible
+
+
+def test_off_without_the_flag(monkeypatch):
+    """No --monokernel: no mono layer, whatever the deployment."""
+    _deployment(monkeypatch, tp=4)
+    assert (
+        md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(_decoder_layer(), _config(monokernel=False)) is None
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case, match",
+    [
+        (dict(tp=4), "tensor parallel size 8"),
+        (dict(aiter_linear=False), "VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR"),
+        (dict(padding="0"), "VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING"),
+    ],
+    ids=["tp", "aiter-linear", "fp8-padding"],
+)
+def test_opt_in_outside_the_kernels_raises(monkeypatch, case, match):
+    """The kernels read TP8 shards of vLLM's preshuffled, padded aiter FP8
+    weights: any other deployment is an error, not garbage."""
+    padding = case.get("padding")
+    _deployment(monkeypatch, **{k: v for k, v in case.items() if k != "padding"})
+    if padding is not None:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING", padding)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=match):
+        md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(_decoder_layer(), _config())
+
+
+def test_hca_key_table_is_vllms_c128a_width(monkeypatch):
+    """The runner's HCA key table is as wide as the c128a table vLLM's metadata
+    builder allocates: every compressed row of the longest context, in 128-row
+    multiples (sparse_mla)."""
+    _deployment(monkeypatch)
+    layer = _decoder_layer(compress_ratio=md.HCA, indexer=None)
+    mono = md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(layer, _config(max_model_len=1_000_000))
+    assert mono is not None and mono.hca_width == 7936

@@ -0,0 +1,355 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode path through the real model: a five-layer
+DeepSeek-V4-Pro at TP8 on CDNA4, served with ``--monokernel`` on and off on
+the same random weights: every decoder layer's outputs at every decode step
+must match. Unlike ``test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py``, which checks the kernels
+against vLLM's ops one stage at a time, this runs
+``DeepseekV4DecoderLayer.forward`` in the engine -- the model's hook, the
+per-step path choice, the weights taken off the layer, the metadata, the
+compressor and the indexer's top-k -- so a change to the decoder layer that
+the kernels do not follow fails here. Scope: eager steps of one token a
+request; speculative decoding's multi-token rows and graph replays are not
+covered.
+
+The checkpoint's own first five layers (``compress_ratios`` 128, 128, 4, 128,
+4; ``num_hash_layers`` 3) hold every variant the kernels build, each taking the
+whole layer (K1 + K2):
+- 0: hash-routed HCA, the first layer (K1 takes the embedding, no fold)
+- 1: hash-routed HCA
+- 2: hash-routed CSA (vLLM's indexer between K1 and K2)
+- 3: bias-routed HCA
+- 4: bias-routed CSA
+A 32K ``max_model_len`` builds the HCA kernels 256 keys wide; the prompts
+(under 8.3K) keep vLLM's c128a decode table at its 128-wide floor, so the
+kernels read a table narrower than they are built for.
+"""
+
+import zlib
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader import register_model_loader
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.dummy_loader import DummyModelLoader
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+MODEL = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro"
+TP = 8
+LOAD_FORMAT = "dsv4_mono_random"
+TRUNCATED = {
+    "num_hidden_layers": 5,
+    # one entry a layer, the MTP layer's included
+    "compress_ratios": [128, 128, 4, 128, 4, 0],
+}
+LAYERS = (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
+STEPS = 5  # decode steps after the prefill's token
+
+
+def _on_cdna4() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    return get_cdna_version() == 4
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def _fill(name: str, t: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """A random value for every weight, seeded by its name (alike on every
+    rank and in every run), in the ranges the checkpoint's formats hold."""
+    if t.device.type == "meta":
+        return  # materialized and filled by the dummy loader's own path
+    g = torch.Generator(device=t.device).manual_seed(zlib.crc32(name.encode()))
+
+    def randn(scale=1.0, shift=0.0):
+        return torch.randn(t.shape, generator=g, device=t.device) * scale + shift
+
+    if t.dtype in (torch.uint8, torch.float8_e8m0fnu) and "scale" in name:

+        # values. Larger random layers make the stack chaotic: atomics' order
+        # alone moves vLLM's own logits run to run.
+        u8 = t.view(torch.uint8)

+        ids = torch.rand(t.shape[0], 384, generator=g, device=t.device)
+        t.copy_(ids.argsort(1)[:, : t.shape[1]])

+        t.copy_(randn(0.5).abs() + 0.5)
+    elif name.endswith(("hc_attn_base", "hc_ffn_base", "attn_sink")):
+        t.copy_(randn(0.1))

+        inter //= get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()

+                if not decode_only(module):

+"""Numerics of the DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode kernels at TP8 on CDNA4 against
+the ops vLLM runs for the same decode step: random weights in the checkpoint's
+formats (FP8 128 x 128 blocks, MXFP4 experts), processed as vLLM processes
+them (aiter's preshuffled shared gate_up, its routed experts' layout).
+
+The whole layer (K1 + K2) against aiter's fused mHC seams, the ROCm attention
+op chain (block-scaled FP8 GEMMs, the fused q norm / RoPE / KV insert, the
+sparse MLA, the inverse-RoPE MXFP8 wo_a BMM), the TP all-reduce and
+``DeepseekV4MoE``: on CSA layers (their top-k) and HCA ones (every compressed
+row), bias-routed and hash-routed, at one- and two-hop widths.
+
+Each stage is compared on its own input, so a failure names the stage. The
+kernels quantize activations as MXFP8 (E8M0 a 32), where vLLM's FP8 GEMMs take
+fp32 scales a 128: where the two differ by more than rounding, each is
+measured against the exact fp32 result and the kernels must be as close to it

+N_HEADS, O_GROUPS, O_RANK = 128, 16, 1024

+    a, b = a.float().reshape(-1), b.float().reshape(-1)

+    wrong scale."""

+def _paged_cache(num_blocks: int, block: int, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[blocks, block, 584] u8 over pages of round_up(block * 584, 576) bytes,
+    the way vLLM binds a packed V4 cache."""
+    page = -(-block * RECORD // ALIGN) * ALIGN
+    raw = torch.zeros(num_blocks * page, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+    return torch.as_strided(raw, (num_blocks, block, RECORD), (page, RECORD, 1))
+
+
+def _clone_cache(cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    raw = torch.as_strided(cache, (cache.shape[0] * cache.stride(0),), (1,)).clone()
+    return torch.as_strided(raw, cache.shape, cache.stride())
+
+
+def _rope(kv: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor, cos_sin: torch.Tensor):
+    """GPT-J RoPE of the last 64 dims (fp32 math) of rows [n, 512] or heads
+    [n, h, 512]."""
+    cs = cos_sin[positions.long()]
+    if kv.dim() == 3:
+        cs = cs[:, None]
+    cos, sin = cs[..., :32], cs[..., 32:]
+    x = kv.float()
+    e, o = x[..., NOPE::2].clone(), x[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2].clone()
+    x[..., NOPE::2] = e * cos - o * sin
+    x[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2] = e * sin + o * cos
+    return x
+
+
+def _write_records(cache, block: int, slots, kv):
+    """fp8_ds_mla records of roped bf16 kv rows at ``slots``: the 448 nope dims
+    in e4m3 with a UE8M0 per 64, the rope dims in bf16, as vLLM's insert."""
+    nope = kv.float()[:, :NOPE].view(-1, 7, 64)
+    exp = torch.ceil(torch.log2(nope.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-4) / 448.0))
+    q = (nope * torch.exp2(-exp)[..., None]).clamp(-448, 448).reshape(-1, NOPE)
+    data = torch.cat(
+        [
+            q.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).view(torch.uint8),
+            kv[:, NOPE:].to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous().view(torch.uint8),
+        ],
+        1,
+    )
+    scales = torch.zeros(kv.shape[0], 8, dtype=torch.uint8, device=kv.device)
+    scales[:, :7] = (exp + 127).clamp(0, 255).to(torch.uint8)
+    flat, d0, s0 = _record_offsets(cache, block, slots)
+    ar = torch.arange(DATA, device=kv.device)
+    flat[(d0[:, None] + ar).reshape(-1)] = data.reshape(-1)
+    ar = torch.arange(8, device=kv.device)
+    flat[(s0[:, None] + ar).reshape(-1)] = scales.reshape(-1)
+
+
+def _record_offsets(cache, block: int, slots):
+    n = cache.untyped_storage().nbytes() - cache.storage_offset()
+    flat = torch.as_strided(cache, (n,), (1,))
+    slots = slots.to(cache.device).long()
+    b, o = slots // block, slots % block
+    return (
+        flat,
+        b * cache.stride(0) + o * DATA,
+        b * cache.stride(0) + block * DATA + o * 8,
+    )
+
+
+def _read_records(cache, block: int, slots) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The fp32 key rows of the records at ``slots``."""
+    flat, d0, s0 = _record_offsets(cache, block, slots)
+    data = flat[(d0[:, None] + torch.arange(DATA, device=cache.device)).reshape(-1)]
+    data = data.view(-1, DATA)
+    sc = flat[(s0[:, None] + torch.arange(7, device=cache.device)).reshape(-1)]
+    nope = data[:, :NOPE].contiguous().view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float().view(-1, 7, 64)
+    nope = nope * torch.exp2(sc.view(-1, 7).float() - 127)[..., None]
+    rope = data[:, NOPE:].contiguous().view(torch.bfloat16).float()
+    return torch.cat([nope.reshape(-1, NOPE), rope], 1)

+def _normed_kv(n: int, kv_norm, g, device):
+    x = torch.randn(n, HEAD_DIM, generator=g).to(device)
+    x = x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True)) * kv_norm.float()

+def _decode_step(ratio: int, R: int, T: int, kv_norm, cos_sin, seed: int):
+    """R requests x T tokens past random contexts: the step's metadata as
+    vLLM's builders lay it out, its window rows and the compressed cache
+    filled; a CSA layer's random top-k a token (request-local indices), an HCA
+    layer's every compressed row (slots, through the block table: vLLM's
+    c128a table)."""
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    dev = kv_norm.device
+    ctx = [int(c) for c in torch.randint(3000, 40000, (R,), generator=g)]
+    M = R * T
+    spans = [
+        (max(0, c - WINDOW - T) // SWA_BLOCK, (c + T - 1) // SWA_BLOCK) for c in ctx
+    ]
+    n_swa = 1 + sum(hi - lo + 1 for lo, hi in spans)
+    perm = (torch.randperm(n_swa - 1, generator=g) + 1).tolist()
+    bt = torch.zeros(R, max(hi for _, hi in spans) + 1, dtype=torch.int64)
+    for r, (lo, hi) in enumerate(spans):
+        for lb in range(lo, hi + 1):
+            bt[r, lb] = perm.pop()
+    swa = _paged_cache(n_swa, SWA_BLOCK, dev)
+
+    def slot(r, p):
+        return int(bt[r, p // SWA_BLOCK]) * SWA_BLOCK + p % SWA_BLOCK
+
+    pos = [ctx[r] + t for r in range(R) for t in range(T)]
+    t2r = [r for r in range(R) for _ in range(T)]
+    swa_idx = torch.full((M, WINDOW), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    swa_len = torch.zeros(M, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for i in range(M):
+        ps = range(max(pos[i] - WINDOW + 1, 0), pos[i] + 1)
+        swa_idx[i, : len(ps)] = torch.tensor([slot(t2r[i], p) for p in ps])
+        swa_len[i] = len(ps)
+    hist = [
+        (r, p) for r in range(R) for p in range(max(0, ctx[r] - WINDOW - T), ctx[r])
+    ]
+    hp = torch.tensor([p for _, p in hist], device=dev)
+    kv = _rope(_normed_kv(len(hist), kv_norm, g, dev), hp, cos_sin)
+    _write_records(swa, SWA_BLOCK, torch.tensor([slot(r, p) for r, p in hist]), kv)
+
+    entries = CACHE_BLOCK // ratio
+    lens = [(c + T) // ratio for c in ctx]
+    nblk = [-(-n // entries) for n in lens]
+    perm = (torch.randperm(sum(nblk), generator=g) + 1).tolist()
+    cbt = torch.zeros(R, max(nblk), dtype=torch.int32)
+    for r in range(R):
+        for b in range(nblk[r]):
+            cbt[r, b] = perm.pop()
+    comp = _paged_cache(1 + sum(nblk), entries, dev)
+    for r in range(R):
+        idx = torch.arange(lens[r])
+        slots = cbt[r, idx // entries].long() * entries + idx % entries
+        kv = _rope(_normed_kv(lens[r], kv_norm, g, dev), (idx * ratio).to(dev), cos_sin)
+        _write_records(comp, entries, slots, kv)
+    if ratio == 4:
+        topk = torch.full((M, TOPK), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+        for i in range(M):
+            cand = (pos[i] + 1) // ratio
+            n = min(cand, TOPK)
+            topk[i, :n] = torch.randperm(cand, generator=g)[:n].to(torch.int32)
+    else:
+        n_max = max((p + 1) // ratio for p in pos)
+        width = max(128, 1 << (n_max - 1).bit_length())
+        topk = torch.full((M, width), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+        for i in range(M):
+            j = torch.arange((pos[i] + 1) // ratio)
+            topk[i, : len(j)] = cbt[t2r[i], j // entries] * entries + j % entries
+    return dict(
+        M=M,
+        positions=torch.tensor(pos, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev),
+        slot_mapping=torch.tensor(
+            [slot(t2r[i], pos[i]) for i in range(M)], dtype=torch.int64, device=dev
+        ),
+        token_to_req=torch.tensor(t2r, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
+        swa_indices=swa_idx.to(dev),
+        swa_lens=swa_len.to(dev),
+        swa_cache=swa,
+        topk=topk.to(dev),
+        comp_cache=comp,
+        comp_block_table=cbt.to(dev),
+        comp_entries=entries,
+    )
+
+
+def _keys(s: dict, i: int, ratio: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Token i's (compressed slots, window slots) of the step."""
+    top = s["topk"][i]
+    top = top[top >= 0].long()
+    if ratio == 4:
+        e, r = s["comp_entries"], s["token_to_req"][i]
+        top = s["comp_block_table"][r, top // e].long() * e + top % e
+    return top, s["swa_indices"][i, : s["swa_lens"][i]].long()
+
+
+def _fp8_block(n: int, k: int, g, device):
+    """A random FP8 weight [n, k] e4m3 and its 128 x 128 block scales as vLLM
+    holds them after loading: the rows padded as on ROCm, fp32 powers of two."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.fp8_utils import (
+        _maybe_pad_fp8_weight,
+    )
+
+    w = torch.randn(n, k, generator=g).clamp(-6, 6).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    s = torch.randint(116, 121, (n // 128, k // 128), generator=g).float()
+    return _maybe_pad_fp8_weight(w.to(device)), torch.exp2(s - 127).to(device)
+
+
+def _deq(w: torch.Tensor, s: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return w.float() * s.repeat_interleave(128, 0).repeat_interleave(128, 1)
+
+
+class _ExactMoE:
+    """A MoE layer's output on this rank in fp32 from its weights as loaded
+    (before post-load processing reshuffles them): MXFP4 / FP8 dequantized,
+    activations unquantized, vLLM's routing."""
+
+    FP4 = (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, -0.0, -0.5, -1, -1.5, -2, -3, -4, -6)
+
+    def __init__(self, moe):
+        e = moe.experts.routed_experts
+        u8 = torch.uint8
+        self.moe = moe
+        self.w13 = (
+            e.w13_weight.data.view(u8).clone(),
+            e.w13_weight_scale.data.view(u8).clone(),
+        )
+        self.w2 = (
+            e.w2_weight.data.view(u8).clone(),
+            e.w2_weight_scale.data.view(u8).clone(),
+        )
+        self.lut = torch.tensor(self.FP4, device=e.w13_weight.device)
+
+    def shared(self, sh) -> None:
+        """The shared expert's weights, after their scales' upcast."""
+
+        def deq(lin):
+            w, sc = lin.weight.float(), lin.weight_scale_inv.float()
+            return w * sc.repeat_interleave(128, 0).repeat_interleave(128, 1)
+
+        self.sgu, self.sd = deq(sh.gate_up_proj), deq(sh.down_proj)
+
+    def _experts(self, raw, ids):
+        w, sc = raw[0][ids], raw[1][ids]
+        lo, hi = self.lut[(w & 15).long()], self.lut[(w >> 4).long()]
+        v = torch.stack([lo, hi], -1).flatten(-2)
+        return v * torch.exp2(sc.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _swiglu(gu):
+        n = gu.shape[-1] // 2
+        g, u = gu[..., :n].clamp(max=10), gu[..., n:].clamp(-10, 10)
+        return torch.nn.functional.silu(g) * u
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor, route: torch.Tensor | None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        moe, x = self.moe, x.float()
+        scores = torch.nn.functional.softplus(x @ moe.gate.weight.float().T).sqrt()
+        if route is None:
+            bias = moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias
+            ids = (scores + bias).topk(moe.n_activated_experts, dim=1).indices
+        else:
+            ids = route.long()
+        w = scores.gather(1, ids)
+        w = w / w.sum(1, keepdim=True) * moe.routed_scaling_factor
+        out = self._swiglu(x @ self.sgu.T) @ self.sd.T
+        for t in range(x.shape[0]):
+            w13, w2 = self._experts(self.w13, ids[t]), self._experts(self.w2, ids[t])
+            act = self._swiglu(torch.einsum("knh,h->kn", w13, x[t]))
+            out[t] += (w[t, :, None] * torch.einsum("khn,kn->kh", w2, act)).sum(0)
+        return out
+
+
+class _ExactAttention:
+    """A layer's attention on this rank in fp32 from its normed input: the
+    weights dequantized, the keys as a cache holds them (the window's rows of
+    the step written by the path under test), wo_b's partial out."""
+
+    def __init__(self, w: dict, eps: float, sink: torch.Tensor):
+        self.wqkv = _deq(w["wqkv"], w["wqkv_s"])
+        self.wq_b = _deq(w["wq_b"], w["wq_b_s"])
+        self.wo_a = _deq(w["wo_a"], w["wo_a_s"])
+        self.wo_b = _deq(w["wo_b"], w["wo_b_s"])
+        self.q_norm, self.kv_norm = w["q_norm"].float(), w["kv_norm"].float()
+        self.eps, self.sink = eps, sink.float()
+
+    def _rms(self, x, w):
+        return x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps) * w
+
+    def kv(self, x, positions, cos_sin) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The KV rows of a step's tokens: kv_norm, then RoPE."""
+        kv = (x.float() @ self.wqkv.T)[:, Q_RANK:]
+        return _rope(self._rms(kv, self.kv_norm), positions, cos_sin)
+
+    def __call__(self, x, s: dict, ratio: int, swa_cache, cos_sin) -> torch.Tensor:
+        M, pos = x.shape[0], s["positions"]
+        qr_kv = x.float() @ self.wqkv.T
+        q = (self._rms(qr_kv[:, :Q_RANK], self.q_norm) @ self.wq_b.T).view(M, -1, 512)
+        q = _rope(self._rms(q, 1.0), pos, cos_sin)
+        heads = q.shape[1]
+        o = torch.empty(M, heads, HEAD_DIM, device=x.device)
+        for i in range(M):
+            top, win = _keys(s, i, ratio)
+            k = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    _read_records(s["comp_cache"], s["comp_entries"], top),
+                    _read_records(swa_cache, SWA_BLOCK, win),
+                ]
+            )
+            sc = (q[i] @ k.T) * HEAD_DIM**-0.5
+            m = torch.maximum(sc.amax(1), self.sink[:heads])
+            p = torch.exp(sc - m[:, None])
+            den = p.sum(1) + torch.exp(self.sink[:heads] - m)
+            o[i] = (p @ k) / den[:, None]
+        # inverse RoPE of each head's last 64 dims
+        cs = cos_sin[pos.long()][:, None]
+        cos, sin = cs[..., :32], cs[..., 32:]
+        e, od = o[..., NOPE::2].clone(), o[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2].clone()
+        o[..., NOPE::2] = e * cos + od * sin
+        o[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2] = od * cos - e * sin
+        groups = self.wo_a.shape[0] // O_RANK
+        og = o.view(M, groups, -1)
+        z = torch.einsum("mgk,gnk->mgn", og, self.wo_a.view(groups, O_RANK, -1))
+        return z.reshape(M, -1) @ self.wo_b.T
+
+
+def _attn_output(runner, epoch: int, M: int, rank: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The wo_b partials every rank pushed to this rank's ATTN region in the
+    launch pair of ``epoch``, summed: [M, hidden] fp32. On two hops a rank
+    holds its own columns' partials only: the ranks' columns gathered."""
+    from vllm.distributed import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd.mono.layer import peer_half_bytes
+
+    half = peer_half_bytes(runner.tp)
+    n = runner.tp * M * HIDDEN // 2
+    base = (epoch & 1) * half
+    pairs = runner.peer.bytes[base : base + n * 8].view(torch.int32).view(n, 2)
+    parts = pairs[:, 0].contiguous().view(torch.bfloat16).view(runner.tp, M, HIDDEN)
+    out = parts.float().sum(0)
+    if runner.two_hop(M):
+        cols = slice(rank * HIDDEN // runner.tp, (rank + 1) * HIDDEN // runner.tp)
+        own = torch.zeros_like(out)
+        own[:, cols] = out[:, cols]
+        out = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(own)
+    return out
+
+

+        x8, xs = ops.group_fp8_quant(xa, transpose_scale=True)

+# DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode layer (gfx950, FlyDSL)
+
+One fused decoder layer for vLLM's decode steps on MI355X: the attention seam,
+the attention, the attention all-reduce, the FFN seam, the MoE and the MoE
+all-reduce, in two persistent launches a layer. This implementation builds on
+the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash mono decode layer (`models/deepseek_v41/amd/mono`).
+[ROCm/ATOM's V4.1 mono decode](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/tree/97359d6df46c59736468168b7be8bc50b482a1a9/atom/models/deepseek_v41/mono)
+is the reference design: its persistent execution framework, synchronization,
+peer memory, mHC seam and MoE stages underpin this implementation. The adapted
+files name their ATOM origins and retain attribution to Advanced Micro
+Devices, Inc., under the MIT License. Here they are specialized to Pro's
+widths and numerics; the attention stages (`attention/`) read vLLM's KV records
+and weights as loaded.
+
+## Scope
+
+- Layers: the whole layer on all 61 backbone layers (CSA, compress ratio 4;
+  HCA, ratio 128; layers 0-2 hash-routed). K1 takes the residual settled,
+  without folding the previous output in, on layer 0 (the embedding broadcast
+  to the four streams). Between K1 and K2 every layer hands vLLM its normed
+  input and bf16 qr (`select`): vLLM's compressor runs there, and on a CSA
+  layer its indexer; K2 then builds the key table, the CSA top-k through the
+  block table or the HCA layer's every compressed row from vLLM's c128a table
+  (`global_keys`), as wide as the longest context (8192 at 1M): its rounds,
+  split chunks and combine cover a token's own keys only (`bounded`). The MTP /
+  DSpark draft layers keep vLLM's path; the paths interleave freely (same
+  tensors at the layer boundary).
+- Steps: decode only (FULL graph or eager), M <= 64 rows (8 requests x 7
+  DSpark tokens and spare), TP8, `fp8_ds_mla` KV records (ROCm).
+- Contract: a drop-in for `DeepseekV4DecoderLayer.forward`:
+  in  `x` (the previous FFN output, reduced, bf16 [M, 7168]), `residual`
+      (bf16 [M, 4, 7168]), `post_mix` [M, 4, 1], `res_mix` [M, 4, 4] (f32)
+  out the MoE output (reduced), the residual after the FFN seam, and that
+      seam's post / comb / pre mixes.
+
+## Launches
+
+    K1  seam (stages/seam.py): slice (224 x 32 columns): fold x into the
+        residual (post x + sum comb r), partial mixes (fn . R') and sums of
+        squares -> gate (S): 24 mixes -> pre / post / comb (Sinkhorn 20) ->
+        norm (S): the collapse (pre . R'), attn_norm -> vLLM MXFP8 -> X8
+        attention front (attention/front.py): wqkv, q / kv norms + KV insert,
+        wq_b + RoPE -> Q; the normed input and qr out for vLLM's compressor
+        and indexer
+    K2  key table (attention/front.py, stage_kt), from the top-k the indexer
+        selected after K1
+        attention back (attention/back.py): split attention (each head's q
+        RMSNorm scaling its scores), combine + inverse RoPE, wo_a, wo_b; the
+        bf16 wo_b partial pushed to every rank, or to its columns' owner
+        FFN seam: reduce (the ranks' partials summed in rank order, fp32 ->
+        bf16: the attention output), slice, gate, norm -> the MoE input
+        MoE (stages/moe.py): xq, router (bf16 GEMV, f32 logits), route
+        (sqrtsoftplus + bias, top-6, renormalized x 2.5; a hash layer's experts
+        given), shared expert (MXFP8 GEMVs, clamped SiLU), ug (MXFP4 x MXFP8 per
+        expert of the step's union), down (+ routing weight, top-k order;
+        + shared) -> push, rank-order sum -> out
+
+## Execution model and hand-offs
+
+- Grid = 256 CTAs (one a CU, all resident), 512 threads a CTA, LDS a per-stage
+  union. A stage is a task table: CTA `b` runs tasks `b, b + 256, ...`, stages
+  in order; a consumer only waits on earlier stages, so no deadlock while the
+  grid is resident. A GEMV task issues its weight loads before it polls its
+  activations.
+- In a launch: tagged pairs (value + tag in one 8 B store) or plain data +
+  flags, at device scope. The tag is the launch pair's epoch (K1 `2e + 1`,
+  K2 `2e + 2`), a device word K2's CTA 0 moves on once every CTA has marked
+  the launch done: no clearing between steps, no host step hook, every
+  argument a fixed device pointer (graph-safe). A step width and key-table
+  width have a scratch of their own: under another layout a pair's tag word
+  could be plain data.
+- Across ranks: one symmetric uncached buffer a rank (aiter `UncachedIpcHeap`),
+  every rank holding every peer's address; pushes are system-scope stores of
+  (value, tag) pairs. Every rank runs the same launches, so the epochs agree;
+  peer regions alternate by epoch parity, and a rank cannot run two steps ahead
+  of a peer (each step's reduce waits on every rank's push).
+
+## Numerics
+
+- Seams: the gate is aiter's `mhc_fused_post_pre_delayed_rmsnorm` reduce (post
+  fold order, fn as bf16 hi + lo, products summed in order, Triton sigmoid /
+  exp / rcp), the collapse aiter's `mhc_pre` (the four streams in fp32 ->
+  bf16, rsq(sum / H + eps), (x w) rstd). The gate matches the fp32 reference;
+  aiter's fused seam is ~2e-3 off it.
+- Attention: activations as MXFP8 (one E8M0 per 32 values, `code =
+  clamp(ceil(log2(amax / 448)) + 127, 0, 254)`), where vLLM's path quantizes
+  per 128 with fp32 scales: the kernels match the exact result no worse.
+  Weights as vLLM loads them: wqkv, wo_b and the shared gate_up in aiter's
+  (16, 16) shuffle, the others e4m3 [N, K] row-major with rows padded as
+  `VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING` pads them; the checkpoint's 128 x 128 E8M0 block
+  scales repeated as [N/32, K/32] (exact). KV records as vLLM's insert writes
+  them (dims 0..447 e4m3 with a UE8M0 per 64, RoPE dims bf16, 584 B); softmax
+  in base 2 with the attention sink folded in.
+- MoE: vLLM's router (bf16 gate GEMV, f32 logits, `topk_hash_softplus_sqrt`)
+  and AITER a8w4 `fused_moe` (interleaved gate / up, swiglu limit 10, weights
+  in aiter's (16, 16) shuffle and `shuffle_scale` order); the shared expert as
+  MXFP8 linears with `silu_and_mul_with_clamp`.
+- All-reduces (`stages/allreduce.py`): exact, fp32 in rank order -> bf16. One
+  hop (every rank pushes its partial to every rank) or, from 42 rows, two (to
+  the column's owner, which sums and pushes the bf16 sum to the others: 2 / tp
+  of the bytes); bit-identical results.
+
+## Validation
+
+- Per layer against vLLM's own modules in a TP8 process group
+  (`tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py`), the protocol under graph
+  replays; through the real model on random weights
+  (`tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_layers.py`); the docking's path choice
+  (`tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_decode.py`).
+- Bench: layers of one type back to back in one HIP graph, cold weights, us
+  per layer; then e2e (GSM8K, GPQA-Diamond, AIME25, RULER NIAH, AgentX as
+  InferenceX runs it).

+"""K2 ``back``: one attention layer from the rotated query to the rank's wo_b
+partial.
+
+One launch a layer and rank, ``BLOCKS`` x ``THREADS``, S rows:
+
+    split   (S x chunks of CK keys): flash-decoding over one chunk of a token's
+            keys (K1's key table: top-k compressed rows, then window rows) for
+            every head of the rank. The token's q in LDS, each head's RMSNorm
+            factor (``q_head_rstd``) from it; each wave one
+            (head tile, 16-key tile): its fp8_ds_mla rows loaded once,
+            dequantized into its QK operands and kept raw in LDS; QK (bf16
+            MFMA), the chunk's max / sum per head, bf16 p in LDS; PV over the
+            chunk's raw rows (wave w: dims 64 w ..) -> the chunk's partial
+            (bf16) and its (max, sum) per head, published
+            A wide key table (``bounded``) skips the chunks past a token's
+            keys, known from its position.
+    combine (S x H): a (token, head)'s chunks merged with the sink folded in
+            (``bounded``: its live chunks only, ``merge_live``),
+            bf16, inverse GPT-J RoPE of dims 448.., vLLM's MXFP8 of each 32
+            -> XO (published)
+    wo_a    (G x 1024 / 32, two 16-row tiles): the group's XO rows times wo_a
+            -> bf16 -> MXFP8 of the 32 rows -> X8B (published)
+    wo_b    (448, 16 rows): X8B times wo_b -> bf16 -> ``out``
+
+Hand-offs are plain device-scope data behind tagged flags (half the bytes of a
+tagged pair per value). Adapted from ATOM's V4.1 ``attn_post`` (K2a), which
+reads a bf16 pool and ends in a peer all-reduce.

+
+def plus(t0, v):
+    return v if isinstance(t0, int) and t0 == 0 else v + t0
+
+
+def head_groups(d: Dims, s: int) -> int:
+    """Wave groups a split unit's head tiles are spread over: two (a tile each,
+    64-key chunks, twice the units) while the units fit the grid, else one (a
+    wave's keys loaded and dequantized once for every head tile)."""
+    return 2 if d.head_tiles == 2 and s * cdiv(d.keys, 64) <= BLOCKS else 1
+
+
+def chunk_keys(d: Dims, s: int) -> int:
+    """A split unit's keys: a 16-key tile a wave of a head group."""
+    return 16 * (WAVES // head_groups(d, s))
+
+
+def p_row(d: Dims, s: int) -> int:
+    """A P row (one head's chunk of bf16 p) in LDS, i32 words."""
+    return chunk_keys(d, s) // 2 + P_PAD
+
+
+@traced
+def publish(c, region, i):
+    """This CTA's stores visible device-wide, then the flag pair (region, i)."""
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if c["tid"] == 0:
+        c["mb"].put(region, i, fx.Int32(1))
+
+
+@traced
+def await_flags(c, region, n, index):
+    """Thread u < n polls flag ``index(u)``; then the CTA proceeds."""
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    if tid < n:
+        c["mb"].poll([(region, index(fx.min(tid, n - 1)), 1)])
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- keys
+
+
+def key_rec(c, t, k):
+    """(data address, scale address, valid) of token t's key k from K1's key
+    table: slot | 1 << 31 for a compressed row, a window slot otherwise, -1 for
+    none (it reads a zero record: its scores are masked, its values zeros)."""
+    a, ratio, keys = c["args"], c["ratio"], c["d"].keys
+    # a table this launch wrote (``krdy``) is read past the CU's cache
+    cm = CM_DEV if const_expr("krdy" in c) else 0
+    val = ld_i32(a["kt"], t * keys + fx.min(fx.max(k, 0), keys - 1), cm)
+    ok = val != fx.Int32(-1)
+    slot = ok.select(val & fx.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF), fx.Int32(0))
+    if const_expr(ratio > 0):
+        is_c = ok & (val < 0)
+        blk = is_c.select(a["comp_block"], a["swa_block"])
+        stride = is_c.select(a["comp_stride"], a["swa_stride"])
+        base = is_c.select(a["comp"], a["swa"])
+    else:
+        blk, stride, base = a["swa_block"], a["swa_stride"], a["swa"]
+    b = slot // blk
+    off = slot % blk
+    page = base + fx.Int64(b) * stride
+    z = a["zrec"]
+    data = ok.select(page + fx.Int64(off * DATA), z)
+    sc = ok.select(page + fx.Int64(blk * DATA + off * 8), z + fx.Int64(DATA))
+    return data, sc, ok
+
+
+def _scale_byte(scw, blk64):
+    return (scw[blk64 // 4] >> (blk64 % 4 * 8)) & 0xFF
+
+
+def _fp8_pair_f32(word, scale, hi):
+    v = rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_f32_fp8(
+        fx.Vector.make_type(2, fx.Float32),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(word)),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Float32(scale)),
+        hi,
+    )
+    v = fx.Vector(v)
+    return [v[0], v[1]]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- split
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_split(c, unit):
+    """Flash-decoding over chunk ``unit % nchunk`` of token ``unit // nchunk``
+    (``split_chunk``). A build whose key table is wider than a token's top-k
+    (``bounded``: every compressed row of a long context) skips a chunk past
+    the token's keys at most, known from its position alone: no load of its q
+    or keys."""
+    nchunk = c["nchunk"]
+    t = unit // nchunk
+    ch = unit % nchunk
+    if const_expr(c.get("bounded", False)):
+        d = c["d"]
+        pos = ld_i32(c["args"]["pos"], 2 * t)
+        cap = fx.min((pos + 1) // c["ratio"], fx.Int32(d.topk_width)) + WINDOW
+        if ch * chunk_keys(d, c["S"]) < cap:
+            split_chunk(c, t, ch)
+    else:
+        split_chunk(c, t, ch)
+
+
+@traced
+def q_head_rstd(c):
+    """Each head's weightless RMSNorm of the token's q in LDS:
+    rsq(mean(q^2) + eps) -> ``qn`` [head]. vLLM norms q before its RoPE, which
+    keeps every pair's norm: the scores scale by it after the dot product."""
+    tid, d, sl = c["tid"], c["d"], c["sl"]
+    tph = THREADS // d.heads  # threads a head
+    words = HEAD_DIM // 2 // tph
+    h = tid // tph
+    i = tid % tph
+    acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for w in range_constexpr(words):
+        v = fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(sl["q"] + (h * Q_ROW + i * words + w)))
+        lo, hi = bf_lo(v), bf_hi(v)
+        acc = acc + lo * lo + hi * hi
+    offs = tuple(o for o in (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1) if o < tph)
+    acc = butterfly(acc, offs)
+    if i == 0:
+        mean = acc * fx.Float32(1.0 / HEAD_DIM)
+        fx.ptr_store(hw_rsq(mean + fx.Float32(NORM_EPS)), sl["qn"] + h)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def split_chunk(c, t, ch):
+    """Flash-decoding over chunk ``ch`` of token ``t``, every head of the rank
+    -> the chunk's partial and (max, sum) per head. Wave (head group hg, key
+    tile kt): keys 16 kt .. of the chunk (loaded and dequantized once) against
+    the group's head tiles; then dims 64 w .. of the PV over every key and
+    head."""
+    tid, lane, wave, d, s = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["d"], c["S"]
+    a, sl = c["args"], c["sl"]
+    nchunk = c["nchunk"]
+    ck = chunk_keys(d, s)
+    ngrp = head_groups(d, s)
+    nkt = WAVES // ngrp  # 16-key tiles a chunk
+    nht = d.head_tiles // ngrp  # head tiles a wave
+    hgi = wave // nkt
+    kt = wave % nkt
+    g = lane // 16
+    r16 = lane % 16
+    k0 = ch * ck
+    if const_expr("krdy" in c):
+        await_flags(c, c["krdy"], 1, lambda u: t)
+    # the key count, this lane's key and q: independent loads, out together
+    # (the key table holds -1 past a token's keys)
+    kv_len = ld_i32(a["klen"], t, CM_DEV if const_expr("krdy" in c) else 0)
+    key = k0 + kt * 16 + r16
+    data, sc, okv = key_rec(c, t, key)
+    qrow = d.heads * HEAD_DIM // 8
+    qv = []
+    for i in range_constexpr(cdiv(qrow, THREADS)):
+        u = fresh(tid) + THREADS * i
+        qv.append(
+            fx.Vector(
+                bo.buffer_load(
+                    rsrc(a["q"]),
+                    (t * d.q_rows) // 2 + fx.min(u, qrow - 1) * 4,
+                    vec_width=4,
+                    dtype=T.i32,
+                )
+            )
+        )
+    if k0 < kv_len:
+        # a key's 448 e4m3 as 7 x 16 B (lane g: dims 64 c + 16 g ..), its 64
+        # bf16 rope dims as 2 x 16 B (32 c + 8 g ..), its 7 scale bytes
+        scw = gload(sc, words=2)
+        nope = [
+            gload(data + fx.Int64(64 * c4 + 16 * g), words=4)
+            for c4 in range(NOPE // 64)
+        ]
+        rope = [
+            gload(data + fx.Int64(NOPE + (cc * 32 + 8 * g) * 2), words=4)
+            for cc in range(ROPE // 32)
+        ]
+        # q of every head into LDS (bf16 rows of 512 + pad), 16 B a thread
+        for i in range_constexpr(cdiv(qrow, THREADS)):
+            u = fresh(tid) + THREADS * i
+            if u < qrow:
+                fx.ptr_store(
+                    qv[i],
+                    sl["q"]
+                    + (u // (HEAD_DIM // 8)) * Q_ROW
+                    + (u % (HEAD_DIM // 8)) * 4,
+                )
+        # the raw rows to LDS for the PV (head group 0's waves)
+        if hgi == 0:
+            rawb = sl["raw"] + (kt * 16 + r16) * (REC // 4)
+            for c4 in range_constexpr(NOPE // 64):
+                fx.ptr_store(nope[c4], rawb + (64 * c4 + 16 * g) // 4)
+            for cc in range_constexpr(ROPE // 32):
+                fx.ptr_store(rope[cc], rawb + (NOPE + (cc * 32 + 8 * g) * 2) // 4)
+            if g == 0:
+                fx.ptr_store(scw, rawb + DATA // 4)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        q_head_rstd(c)
+        stamp(c, 5)
+        # QK: A = the keys (dequantized once), B = q of a head tile (LDS); the
+        # contraction's 32-dim chunk 2 c + h of the nope dims is {64 c + 16 g +
+        # 8 h ..} (lane g's 16 B load), q read in the same order
+        scale = fx.Int32(a["qk_scale"]).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+        st = sl["st"]
+        accs = [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(nht)]
+        for c4 in range_constexpr(NOPE // 64):
+            ksc = pow2(_scale_byte(scw, c4))
+            for h2 in range_constexpr(2):
+                kw = fp8x8_bf16(nope[c4][2 * h2], nope[c4][2 * h2 + 1], ksc).bitcast(
+                    fx.BFloat16
+                )
+                for ht in range_constexpr(nht):
+                    qb = sl["q"] + ((hgi * nht + ht) * HEAD_TILE + r16) * Q_ROW
+                    qw = fx.Vector(
+                        fx.ptr_load(
+                            qb + 32 * c4 + 8 * g + 4 * h2,
+                            result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                        )
+                    )
+                    accs[ht] = mfma_bf16(kw, qw.bitcast(fx.BFloat16), accs[ht])
+        for cc in range_constexpr(ROPE // 32):
+            kw = rope[cc].bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+            for ht in range_constexpr(nht):
+                qb = sl["q"] + ((hgi * nht + ht) * HEAD_TILE + r16) * Q_ROW
+                qw = fx.Vector(
+                    fx.ptr_load(
+                        qb + (NOPE + cc * 32 + 8 * g) // 2,
+                        result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                    )
+                )
+                accs[ht] = mfma_bf16(kw, qw.bitcast(fx.BFloat16), accs[ht])
+        # scores of keys 4 g + i (C rows), head r16 of a tile (C column)
+        ok = (key < kv_len) & okv
+        okw = ok.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+        valid = [lane_gather(okw, 4 * g + i) != 0 for i in range(4)]
+        svs = []
+        for ht in range_constexpr(nht):
+            head = (hgi * nht + ht) * HEAD_TILE + r16
+            hscale = scale * fx.ptr_load(sl["qn"] + head)
+            sv = [
+                fx.Float32(valid[i].select(accs[ht][i] * hscale, fx.Float32(NEG)))
+                for i in range(4)
+            ]
+            mw = butterfly(
+                fx.max(fx.max(sv[0], sv[1]), fx.max(sv[2], sv[3])), (32, 16), fx.max
+            )
+            if g == 0:
+                fx.ptr_store(mw, st + ((hgi * nht + ht) * nkt + kt) * HEAD_TILE + r16)
+            svs.append(sv)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        lst = st + d.heads * nkt
+        for ht in range_constexpr(nht):
+            hti = hgi * nht + ht
+            m = fx.ptr_load(st + (hti * nkt) * HEAD_TILE + r16)
+            for j in range_constexpr(1, nkt):
+                m = fx.max(m, fx.ptr_load(st + (hti * nkt + j) * HEAD_TILE + r16))
+            sv = svs[ht]
+            p = [
+                fx.Float32(valid[i].select(hw_exp2(sv[i] - m), fx.Float32(0.0)))
+                for i in range(4)
+            ]
+            lw = (p[0] + p[2]) + (p[1] + p[3])
+            lw = lw + xshfl(lw, 32)
+            lw = lw + xshfl(lw, 16)
+            pw = (
+                fx.Vector.from_elements(p, fx.Float32).to(fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int32)
+            )
+            pbase = (
+                sl["p"] + (hti * HEAD_TILE + r16) * p_row(d, s) + (kt * 16 + 4 * g) // 2
+            )
+            fx.ptr_store(fx.Vector.from_elements([pw[0], pw[1]], fx.Int32), pbase)
+            if g == 0:
+                fx.ptr_store(lw, lst + (hti * nkt + kt) * HEAD_TILE + r16)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        # chunk stats: (max, sum) per head
+        if tid < d.heads:
+            hts = tid // HEAD_TILE
+            hr = tid % HEAD_TILE
+            mm = fx.ptr_load(st + (hts * nkt) * HEAD_TILE + hr)
+            ll = fx.ptr_load(lst + (hts * nkt) * HEAD_TILE + hr)
+            for j in range_constexpr(1, nkt):
+                mm = fx.max(mm, fx.ptr_load(st + (hts * nkt + j) * HEAD_TILE + hr))
+                ll = ll + fx.ptr_load(lst + (hts * nkt + j) * HEAD_TILE + hr)
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                fx.Vector.from_elements([mm, ll], fx.Float32),
+                rsrc(c["pstat"]),
+                ((t * nchunk + ch) * d.heads + tid) * 2,
+                cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+            )
+        # PV: wave w dims 64 w + 4 r16 + dt (dt = 0..3: one LDS word holds the
+        # four of a key); the rope wave (dims 448..) reads bf16 pairs. Lane
+        # (r16, g) takes keys 4 g + j of a 16-key tile: A[dim][key]
+        is_rope = wave == WAVES - 1
+        dbase = 64 * wave
+        sh = (wave % 4) * 8
+        accs = [
+            [fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32) for _ in range(4)]
+            for _ in range(d.head_tiles)
+        ]
+        for kt2 in range_constexpr(nkt):
+            rb0 = sl["raw"] + (kt2 * 16 + 4 * g) * (REC // 4)
+            vv = fx.Vector.filled(16, 0.0, fx.Float32)  # [dt][j]
+            if is_rope:
+                rv = []
+                for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                    rw = fx.Vector(
+                        fx.ptr_load(
+                            rb0 + j * (REC // 4) + (NOPE + 8 * r16) // 4,
+                            result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(2, fx.Int32),
+                        )
+                    )
+                    rv.append([bf_lo(rw[0]), bf_hi(rw[0]), bf_lo(rw[1]), bf_hi(rw[1])])
+                vv = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [rv[j][dt] for dt in range(4) for j in range(4)], fx.Float32
+                )
+            else:
+                nv = []
+                for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                    rb = rb0 + j * (REC // 4)
+                    w = fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(rb + (dbase + 4 * r16) // 4))
+                    scb = fx.Int32(fx.ptr_load(rb + DATA // 4 + wave // 4))
+                    scl = pow2((scb >> sh) & 0xFF)
+                    nv.append(
+                        _fp8_pair_f32(w, scl, False) + _fp8_pair_f32(w, scl, True)
+                    )
+                vv = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [nv[j][dt] for dt in range(4) for j in range(4)], fx.Float32
+                )
+            for ht2 in range_constexpr(d.head_tiles):
+                pb = fx.Vector(
+                    fx.ptr_load(
+                        sl["p"]
+                        + (ht2 * HEAD_TILE + r16) * p_row(d, s)
+                        + (kt2 * 16 + 4 * g) // 2,
+                        result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(2, fx.Int32),
+                    )
+                ).bitcast(fx.Int16)
+                for dt in range_constexpr(4):
+                    av = (
+                        fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                            [vv[dt * 4 + j] for j in range(4)], fx.Float32
+                        )
+                        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+                        .bitcast(fx.Int16)
+                    )
+                    accs[ht2][dt] = fx.Vector(
+                        rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x16bf16_1k(
+                            T.vec(4, T.f32), [av, pb, accs[ht2][dt]]
+                        )
+                    )
+        stamp(c, 6)
+        # partial[t][ch][head][dim] bf16: lane (r16, g) holds C rows 4 g + i ->
+        # dims 64 w + 16 g + 4 i + dt of head ht2 * 16 + r16: 32 contiguous
+        # bytes, two 16 B stores (4 lanes fill a 128 B line)
+        for ht2 in range_constexpr(d.head_tiles):
+            hh = ht2 * HEAD_TILE + r16
+            words = []
+            for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                v4 = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [accs[ht2][dt][i] for dt in range(4)], fx.Float32
+                )
+                w2 = v4.to(fx.BFloat16).bitcast(fx.Int32)
+                words += [w2[0], w2[1]]
+            off = (((t * nchunk + ch) * d.heads + hh) * HEAD_DIM + dbase + 16 * g) // 2
+            for hlf in range_constexpr(2):
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(words[4 * hlf : 4 * hlf + 4], fx.Int32),
+                    rsrc(c["part"]),
+                    off + 4 * hlf,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                )
+        publish(c, c["srdy"], t * nchunk + ch)
+        stamp(c, 7)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- combine
+
+
+def _chunk_loads(c, t, h, d0, cc):
+    """Chunk cc's (max, sum) of head h and its partial's 8 dims from d0."""
+    d, nchunk = c["d"], c["nchunk"]
+    stv = fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(
+            rsrc(c["pstat"]),
+            ((t * nchunk + cc) * d.heads + h) * 2,
+            vec_width=2,
+            dtype=T.f32,
+        )
+    )
+    pv = fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(
+            rsrc(c["part"]),
+            (((t * nchunk + cc) * d.heads + h) * HEAD_DIM + d0) // 2,
+            vec_width=4,
+            dtype=T.i32,
+        )
+    )
+    vals = []
+    for e in range_constexpr(4):
+        vals += [bf_lo(pv[e]), bf_hi(pv[e])]
+    return stv, vals
+
+
+def merge_all(c, t, h, d0, nlive, sink):
+    """The chunks' (sum, 8 dims) of (t, h) weighted by exp2(max - the max),
+    the sink's term first, in chunk order: every chunk loaded at once (a
+    past-``nlive`` chunk weighs nothing)."""
+    m = fx.Float32(NEG)
+    ms, ls, vs = [], [], []
+    for cc in range_constexpr(c["nchunk"]):
+        live = cc < nlive
+        stv, vals = _chunk_loads(c, t, h, d0, cc)
+        mc = fx.Float32(live.select(stv[0], fx.Float32(NEG)))
+        ms.append(mc)
+        ls.append(fx.Float32(live.select(stv[1], fx.Float32(0.0))))
+        vs.append([fx.Float32(live.select(v, fx.Float32(0.0))) for v in vals])
+        m = fx.max(m, mc)
+    m_final = fx.max(m, sink)
+    lsum = hw_exp2(sink - m_final)
+    tot = [fx.Float32(0.0)] * 8
+    for cc in range_constexpr(c["nchunk"]):
+        wgt = hw_exp2(ms[cc] - m_final)
+        lsum = lsum + ls[cc] * wgt
+        tot = [tot[e] + vs[cc][e] * wgt for e in range(8)]
+    return lsum, tot
+
+
+MERGE_BATCH = 4  # a wide table's chunks loaded together (``merge_live``)
+
+
+@traced
+def merge_live(c, t, h, d0, nlive, sink):
+    """``merge_all`` over the live chunks only, ``MERGE_BATCH`` at a time (a
+    wide key table: most of its chunks past a token's keys)."""
+    m = fx.Float32(NEG)
+    for c0 in range(0, nlive, MERGE_BATCH):
+        for u in range_constexpr(MERGE_BATCH):
+            live = c0 + u < nlive
+            stv, _ = _chunk_loads(c, t, h, d0, fx.min(c0 + u, nlive - 1))
+            m = fx.max(m, fx.Float32(live.select(stv[0], fx.Float32(NEG))))
+    m_final = fx.max(m, sink)
+    lsum = hw_exp2(sink - m_final)
+    t0, t1, t2, t3, t4, t5, t6, t7 = [fx.Float32(0.0)] * 8
+    for c0 in range(0, nlive, MERGE_BATCH):
+        got = [
+            _chunk_loads(c, t, h, d0, fx.min(c0 + u, nlive - 1))
+            for u in range(MERGE_BATCH)
+        ]
+        for u in range_constexpr(MERGE_BATCH):
+            live = c0 + u < nlive
+            stv, vals = got[u]
+            wgt = hw_exp2(fx.Float32(live.select(stv[0], fx.Float32(NEG))) - m_final)
+            lsum = lsum + fx.Float32(live.select(stv[1], fx.Float32(0.0))) * wgt
+            v = [fx.Float32(live.select(x, fx.Float32(0.0))) for x in vals]
+            t0, t1, t2, t3 = (
+                t0 + v[0] * wgt,
+                t1 + v[1] * wgt,
+                t2 + v[2] * wgt,
+                t3 + v[3] * wgt,
+            )
+            t4, t5, t6, t7 = (
+                t4 + v[4] * wgt,
+                t5 + v[5] * wgt,
+                t6 + v[6] * wgt,
+                t7 + v[7] * wgt,
+            )
+    return lsum, [t0, t1, t2, t3, t4, t5, t6, t7]
+
+
+COMB_HEADS = WAVES  # heads a combine unit: a wave each
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_combine(c, unit):
+    """(token, 8 heads) ``unit``, a wave a head, 8 dims a lane: the chunks
+    merged with the sink folded in, bf16, inverse RoPE, MXFP8 of each 32 -> XO,
+    published (a flag a (token, head group))."""
+    lane, wave, d, s = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["d"], c["S"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    hg_n = d.heads // COMB_HEADS
+    t = unit // hg_n
+    hg = unit % hg_n
+    h = hg * COMB_HEADS + wave
+    nchunk = c["nchunk"]
+    ck = chunk_keys(d, s)
+    if const_expr("krdy" in c):
+        # a key table this launch builds: its count once published, past the
+        # CU's cache (a CTA without split work gets here first)
+        await_flags(c, c["krdy"], 1, lambda u: t)
